name: @561-group/fizzos
description: FizzOS — the MUD driver over TAB (@561-group/tab), an homage to FluffOS. TAB is the general ontology/existential base; FizzOS consolidates the MUD-specific concerns (practicing/socializing/saying/mailing/factions/fighting/crafting) so MUD games (e.g. ruinfold) ride this driver rather than reaching into TAB's internals. Pieces migrate here from TAB incrementally; today it re-exports the MUD-flavoured TAB surface.
